system.description:
You can manipulate particles of black carbon packed with potential energy. While your Dust Veil is active, As an action you can select a point you can see no more than 60 feet away and fill a 20-foot cube centered on this point with a highly corrosive cloud of carbon. The cloud spreads around corners, and its area is lightly obscured. It lasts for 1 minute or until a wind of moderate speed disperses it. All creatures that begin their turn in this cloud must make a Constitution saving throw being Envenomed on a failure. This cloud itself is counted as having 2 ranks of Volatile.

Potency I: Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature with a Jiton Clan Hijutsu, they become Volatile.

Potency II: When you spend your action to generate a cloud, you can select two points you can see, and the affected areas becomes heavily obscured and difficult terrain. Creatures that fail their saving throw within the cloud becomes Blinded until the end of their following turns.
